caption: The drawing depicts a wooden side table with three drawers positioned under the tabletop. The table is rendered in shades of brown, highlighting the wood grain texture and providing a naturalistic appearance. The table stands on four long, curved cabriole legs that each taper downwards and curl slightly at the feet. Each drawer is fitted with a brass-colored handle in the center. The front and sides of the table are framed with lines to outline the drawers and provide a sense of depth. The table’s edges, skirt, and legs feature decorative curves and cutouts. The background is plain and light, with no additional objects, creating a clear contrast that focuses attention on the table itself. The artist’s name, "Arthur Johnson," is lightly printed in the lower left corner.
title: Lowboy
